description: Post a new bug bounty on VibeFix. Free bounties go live immediately. Paid bounties return a checkout URL to complete payment in the browser. Requires VIBEFIX_API_KEY on a customer account.

bountyUsd.description: Cash bounty in USD (e.g. 25 for $25). Omit or set to 0 for a free bounty.

chipsStaked.description: VF Chips to stake as difficulty signal (default 1, min 1)

codeLink.description: Link to the repo or relevant code

description.description: Full description of the bug or issue

platform.description: The vibe coding platform the app was built with

stepsToReproduce.description: Step-by-step instructions to reproduce the bug

title.description: Short title describing the bug (e.g. "Login broken on Safari mobile")

name: vibefix_post_bounty
